description: This file defines the interface and implementation for managing user artifacts in a Cuttlefish Android emulator environment, including directory management, artifact upload/update, extraction, and related utilities.

classes.name: UserArtifactsDirResolver
classes.description: Interface to resolve full directory paths for user artifacts.

classes.name: UserArtifactChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of user artifact data to be uploaded or processed.

classes.name: UserArtifactsManager
classes.description: Interface for managing user artifacts including directory listing, uploading chunks, and extraction.

classes.name: UserArtifactsManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserArtifactsManager interface managing artifact storage and manipulation.

methods.name: NewDir
methods.description: Creates a new user artifact directory.

methods.name: GetDirPath
methods.description: Returns the full path of a given directory name.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Constructs the path for a file within a specific directory.

methods.name: UpdateArtifact
methods.description: Updates or creates an artifact chunk in a specified directory.

methods.name: ExtractArtifact
methods.description: Extracts an artifact (tar.gz or zip) in the specified directory.
